A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same 38-page Zoom-IQA study, including 18 supplementary pages. Text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices are readable and reliably matchable across versions.

before.justification: v3 reports original IQA evaluations, restoration experiments, ablations, saliency analysis, and supplementary human-evaluation and runtime results.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results, including the benchmark comparisons and ablations in Tables 1–6 and supplementary evaluations in Tables 7–8.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same GR-IQA filtering pipeline, two-stage SFT/RL procedure, interactive cropping, KL-Coverage regularizer, progressive re-sampling, and reward components.

E1.justification: Training data and evaluation coverage are unchanged: the seven IQA benchmarks, DIV2K and RealLQ250 restoration tasks, and supplementary bokeh and low-light examples all remain.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the score, reasoning, restoration, grounding, and runtime comparisons. Q-Insight, VisualQuality-R1, DepictQA, DeQA-Score, and LLaVA remain in their respective comparisons.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 retains the same model, training settings, and evaluation metrics. Reasoning-evaluation procedures also match, including the supplementary human study with 15 annotators and 30 images.

E4.justification: The component ablations, center-crop and SFT controls, saliency analysis, evaluator-bias checks, and background-degradation case studies are unchanged, including their supporting tables and examples.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point-estimate reporting. Neither adds or revises repeated-run information, seeds, confidence intervals, variability estimates, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Numerical results and qualitative findings match throughout the main text and supplement. For example, Table 1 retains Zoom-IQA's KonIQ PLCC/SRCC of 0.938/0.922; human-evaluation and runtime results also remain identical.

T1.justification: The SFT loss and mathematical definitions in Equations 1–6, including token covariance, masked KL-Coverage, and rewards, are unchanged. Equation movement reflects pagination only.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims concerning GR-IQA, interactive region-aware reasoning, robustness, and downstream restoration.

C2.justification: Interpretations of learned zooming, RL versus SFT, saliency grounding, background bokeh, night-time noise, and inference latency remain unchanged. No substantive limitation or applicability qualification is added or removed.

D1.justification: Implementation hyperparameters, filtering thresholds, prompt templates, H200/vLLM inference information, and the project-page URL are unchanged. Supplementary section renumbering does not alter reproducibility information.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, positioning against prior methods, and all 85 reference entries are unchanged.

P1.justification: v4 changes Guoqiang Liang's affiliation from NTU S-Lab to the National University of Singapore, removes Section 6's funding acknowledgment, and renumbers supplementary Sections 7–12 as 6–11. Research prose is otherwise retained.

P2.justification: The expanded affiliation block causes text reflow across early pages, while acknowledgment removal leaves additional space on page 15. Figure and table designs, captions, and content remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v4 updates affiliation information and removes the funding acknowledgment, with limited reflow and renumbering. Although funding disclosure is lost, the scientific argument, empirical support, explanations, and reproducibility details remain unchanged; the edits do not establish a meaningful overall quality difference.
